mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, signaling a weakening housing market, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth falls by > 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and rising, signaling a weakening labor market, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by falling payroll employment (PAYEMS).
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 45% of triggered instances, or PAYEMS is also falling but returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and rising, signaling strong manufacturing activity, it will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by accelerating GDP growth (GDPC1).
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or GDPC1 is also accelerating but returns are negative in > 35% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and falling, signaling an accommodative monetary policy, it will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by falling unemployment (UNRATE).
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and falling, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 35% of triggered instances, or UNRATE is also falling but returns are negative in > 30% of instances.
